Steps:
1. Read src/design/WF02-qry05-sbx01-03-20260818.md in full
2. Read docs/requirements.yaml entries for QRY-05, SBX-01, SBX-02, SBX-03
3. Implement per design:
   a. migrations/1169_qry05_entity_field_grants.sql (entity_field_restrictions + user_entity_grants tables)
   b. migrations/1170_sbx_task_specs_agent_sandboxes.sql (task_specs + agent_sandboxes tables)
   c. src/entities/query/field_grants.zig (loadFieldGrants, stripDeniedFields)
   d. src/entities/query/allowlist.zig update: narrowAllowlist() for denied-field filter/sort guard
   e. src/api/routes/entity_query.zig update: serialiseRowsWithStripping()
   f. src/api/middleware/agent_auth.zig (requireOrchestratorSubmit, requireImplementerClaim, requireImplementerExecution)
   g. src/crypto/canonical_json.zig (RFC 8785 canonical JSON)
   h. src/api/routes/agent_task_specs.zig (POST handler with orchestrator gate + server-authoritative principal)
   i. src/api/routes/agent_sandboxes.zig (GET with role-differentiated view + claim endpoint with role gates)
   j. Extend src/api/middleware/auth.zig: agent_realm_roles[], token_scopes[], conflicting-roles guard in authenticate()
   k. Extend src/api/api_mod.zig / src/main.zig to wire new routes

   m. run: zig build check (must exit 0)
4. git add -A && git commit -m 'feat(QRY-05/SBX-01-03): field stripping + orchestrator role gates'
5. git push origin feature/WF02-qry05-sbx01-03-20260818

Return PASS when zig build check exits 0 and commit is pushed.
